correctness.rationale: On cell x=(j+s)/n, u_n=n^(-1/3)p_j and u_n'=n^(2/3)d_j, so the defect-square, derivative-sixth-power and dx factors combine to exactly n c_j. The chord error for t^(1/3) gives c_j=O(j^-6). Expanding d_j and p_j^3-(j+s) uniformly gives d_j^6=(1/729)j^-4(1+O(j^-1)) and defect=s(s-1)/(3j)+O(j^-2), hence c_j=(1/196830)j^-6+O(j^-7). The p-series tail then gives the stated n^-4 correction. The exact first cell is 8/105. The bundled high-precision verifier independently matches C and the asymptotic constants but is only corroborative.
